summary: The 2026.10.9 variant of the pinned android-fs-compat set also covers dist/ca-D3c9PAvv.mjs: both resolveSystemBin("openssl") calls of the secret egress proxy CA module search the fixed Termux bin directory after the system directories (63687cc6 -> 5b1fd3ec), the same line the 2026.9.6 production install received by hand on 25/09. With secrets.egressProxy configured as in production, the 2026.10.9 Gateway now starts and its proxy carries traffic.
reason: S24 preproduction rehearsal (01/11): with secrets.egressProxy the 2026.10.9 Gateway stopped with 'Secret egress proxy Worker is unavailable' and started automatic triage. The Worker hides its error; the candidate's own startSecretEgressProxyServer, run on the S24, throws 'openssl is required to generate secret egress proxy certificates' from ca-D3c9PAvv.mjs inside withFileLock: resolveSystemBin only searches /usr/bin, /bin, /usr/sbin, /sbin, /run/current-system/sw/bin and /snap/bin, and Android has openssl only in /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin. Not @openclaw/fs-safe: the file lock passes and no path is refused. Production 2026.9.6 works only through an out-of-tree hand patch of ca-eRx2gloh.mjs (backup .bak-termux-egress-20260925), lost when the OpenClaw tree is replaced.

tests.evidence: 12 tests (Node 22, openssl of the container): every 2026.10.9 variant applies, checks, stays unchanged and rolls back exactly on the captured npm modules, now including ca-D3c9PAvv.mjs; test_secret_egress_ca_finds_termux_openssl runs the published CA module with the published resolveSystemBin, original then patched by the real owner, with an Android view of the system directories: the original throws the exact S24 error without calling openssl, the patched module probes the Termux directory last, creates a CA (CN=OpenClaw Secret Egress Proxy, key 600) and a leaf valid for its host; test_android_set_refuses_an_unknown_ca_module_before_any_write: apply, rollback and check refuse unsupported_module_hash:dist/ca-D3c9PAvv.mjs and write nothing. Already registered in ci.yml.

limitations: Preproduction proof only (S24 upgrade-rehearsal, 01/11, port 19789, isolated state, channels and WhatsApp skipped): the set applied by the real owner (applied, changed 1, then verified; S24 hash 5b1fd3ec equals the container); Gateway 2026.10.9 with secrets.egressProxy {enabled: true, allowedHosts: []} listening in 51.5 s, /health 200 in 65 s, health --json ok with the Samantha plugin, status secretEgressProxy ready with 0 failed certificates, no triage; through the Gateway exec tool and a dummy store entry bound to example.com, curl got 200 from example.com and a proxy 403 for www.iana.org. Gateway stopped, dummy entry removed, preprod config restored byte for byte. Production not touched.
No effect on the installed 2026.9.6: its hand patch is neither adopted nor removed.
PR #507 still refuses egress_proxy in its preflight; it must depend on this entry (see the PR description).
rollback: Revert. On a 2026.10.9 candidate the deploy rollback restores the original modules of the set, the CA module included.
